Subject: BrightLane vendor activation: required tax docs, VAT certificate, and PO process

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for partnering with Redwood Inference. I'm Marissa on the vendor ops side; copying Connor (procurement) and Neha (finance) to get BrightLane set up for PO issuance and payments.

Action items to get started (please reply with items you can provide this week):
- Signed tax form: W-9 (US vendors) OR W-8BEN-E (non-US). If you are VAT-registered in an EU country, please also attach your VAT registration certificate.
- Legal company name and registered address (must match tax form).
- Remittance and bank instructions: we require bank details via our secure upload link (see below). Do not send account numbers in the body of an email.
- Completed vendor intake template (attached RL_vendor_intake_template.xlsx) — helps us fill the vendor record and remittance contact.

Notes on PO and invoicing:
- Our PO numbers for BrightLane will use the RL- prefix. Please include the PO number on all invoices and the vendor name exactly as in the intake template.
- Invoices should be emailed to accounts@brightlane.ai (we will confirm final invoice route with Neha).

Secure upload link for bank details and sensitive docs: https://secure-upload.redwoodinference.com/brightlane-bank-details
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-7843

If you can attach the W-8BEN-E and VAT cert in reply, we can move to PO creation on our side.

Thanks — quick responses help speed the activation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: RL_vendor_intake_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

Thanks for the clear checklist. BrightLane is a Portugal-based entity (BrightLane Analytics S.A.). We are non-US, so attached is our completed W-8BEN-E and our VAT registration certificate. Also attached a filled vendor intake sheet — legal name and registered address are included there.

Quick questions:
- Can you confirm the PO prefix and whether you require the bank details on a template? We try to avoid sending full bank details over email.
- Remittance email for invoices should be invoices@brightlane.ai but we can also accept invoices to accounts@brightlane.ai if that is your preference.

We'll upload bank instructions to the secure link you provided.

Regards,
